listing.description:
Stop generating generic AI images. Start generating cinema.

This isn't another prompt dump from someone who watched a YouTube tutorial. The AI Cinematographer is built by a working cinematographer with real production experience — every prompt is crafted with actual knowledge of lens choices, lighting setups, composition theory, and color science.

🎬 WHAT YOU GET:
• 60+ production-grade prompts organized by shot type
• Wide shots, mediums, close-ups, specialty shots, lighting setups
• 5 genre modifier templates (Horror, Sci-Fi, Romance, Documentary, Noir)
• 3 negative prompt templates for clean, cinematic output
• Platform-specific settings for Midjourney, DALL-E, and Stable Diffusion
• Quick reference card for on-the-fly use

🎯 WHO THIS IS FOR:
• Content creators who want cinematic-quality AI visuals
• Filmmakers previsualizating shots before production
• Storyboard artists building reference imagery
• Social media creators leveling up their visual game
• Anyone tired of generic, flat AI-generated images

💡 THE DIFFERENCE:
Every prompt references real cinematography concepts — Rembrandt lighting, anamorphic lens characteristics, specific film stocks, actual camera systems. This is the knowledge gap between 'AI art' and 'AI cinema.'

Instant digital download. Use for personal and commercial projects.
